titleEn: Reply to a customer with text

en: How do I reply to a customer?

steps: Status ticks: sending, sent, delivered, read, not sent (Try again)
edgeCases: 24-hour window closed: free text blocked (Meta 131047), only an approved template can be sent
No active package: sends, agent and number connect answer 403 plan_required (no free plan, WA-NOFREE-1); a past_due package keeps replies/confirmations up to 7 days
Per-number throughput limit (130429 / 131056 pair limit): sends are queued and retried by the throttle
Workspace suspended by Ebda: every write answers 403 workspace_suspended (reading, paying and erasing a contact still work)
Customer opted out of marketing: service replies still work
Offline: queued in browser and sent when back online
Enqueue failure marks the row failed (never an orphan queued)
assistantNote: sends a message to a customer
